edits.before: Best wave: a Q-cleared middle wave that keeps your R timer flexible — Galio waves are about being free to leave. Worst wave: a hard-shoved wave when your bot lane is fighting — the R you couldn't channel is the fight your team lost. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.

Worst wave: a wave held under his tower, where you farm inside 900-range poke for nothing. Crash timing: crash and roam — his shove cannot follow you, and Hero's Entrance answers whatever he bombs.

notes: Two slots were swapped throughout the content layer — Satchel Charge (W) was described as wave zoning and Hexplosive Minefield (E) as his escape, when it is the other way round — and that reversal was driving the advice. Corrected everywhere. The full-layer chart disagreed with the content layer on all seven rows and was realigned to the packet values with new whys and ratings. I also moved the matchup from TRICKY 7/10 to EVEN 5.5/10 on a 50.55% win rate over 1555 games plus a chart giving Galio four rows including every phase from level 6. One thing I did NOT write: the brief's missingInteractions carries a 'resistances-invalidated' rule for Satchel Charge derived from a percentHealth flag, but Riot's own W text describes only magic damage and a knockback with no percent-health component. Treating that flag as a tooltip-parse misfire and leaving the claim out.
